"""Read build records for the dashboard."""

import json
from pathlib import Path


def builds(path="builds.json"):
    """Return each build as a dict with name and status, exactly as stored."""
    records = json.loads(Path(path).read_text())
    return [{"name": r["name"], "status": r["status"]} for r in records]

"""Acceptance check for the build table. Run: python -B check_status.py"""

import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

from status import label
from view import row

CASES = [
    ("build-1", " OK ", "passed"),
    ("build-2", "OK", "passed"),
    ("build-3", "ok", "passed"),
    ("build-4", "fail", "failed"),
    ("build-5", "queued", "unknown"),
]
MOBILE_VIEW = "933356707e34b6b00abdc66b256d933f152940d879eb55e9d323d30176cc97ed"

lines = []
for name, raw, expected in CASES:
    shown, wanted = row(name, label(raw)), f"{name}: {expected}"
    line = f"{json.dumps(raw)} shows {json.dumps(shown)}"
    lines.append(f"PASS  {line}" if shown == wanted else f"FAIL  {line}, expected {expected}")
same = hashlib.sha256(Path("view.py").read_bytes()).hexdigest() == MOBILE_VIEW
lines.append(("PASS" if same else "FAIL") + "  view.py is the file the mobile app uses")
print(f"check_status.py: {len(lines)} cases, {sum(x.startswith('FAIL') for x in lines)} failed")
print("\n".join(lines))
